# youtrack_tag (Resource)

Manages an issue tag. The tag is owned by the user of the token.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the tag.

### Optional

- `color_id` (String) Index of the color in the YouTrack palette, from `0` to `35`.
- `untag_on_resolve` (Boolean) Whether the tag is removed when an issue is resolved.
- `updateable_by_group_id` (String) Database ID of the group that can edit the tag.
- `visible_for_group_id` (String) Database ID of the group that can see the tag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Database ID of the tag.
